description: This file contains functions related to listing and managing help desk tickets in the vtiger CRM system, including retrieving user-specific tickets and generating parent links for tickets.

methods.name: getMyTickets
methods.description: Retrieves a list of open tickets assigned to the current user, with options to calculate count or fetch ticket details.

methods.name: getParentLink
methods.description: Generates a link to the parent (Account or Contact) associated with a ticket based on parent ID.
